name: Grilled chicken wings
summary: Cánh gà nướng is grilled chicken wings, part of the cold-night grill spread by hồ Sa Pa.
howToEat: Order a few with the pork skewers and salmon and eat them at the stall.
where: The grill stalls at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down to the market, on cold evenings.
seoTitle: Grilled chicken wings in Sapa — the lake grills
seoDescription: Cánh gà nướng on the cold-night grills at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down to the market.
